Method of Attack: Infect native Android OS libraries and core operating system processes
Elevate privileges using exploits in third-party Android apps to tamper with core Android OS files
Modify native system libraries to load malicious components (libz.so, libcutils.so, liblog.so) that execute as root
Attack Vector: Installation of infected Android apps from third-party stores containing Loki and privilege escalation exploits
Indicators of Compromise: Modification of native Android system_server process (February variant)
Modification of native system libraries with added dependencies loading Loki components (December variant)
Presence of Loki components libz.so, libcutils.so, liblog.so in system libraries
